segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Sells Apple's hardware products and services to customers across North and South America.
segments.evidence: The Company's reportable segments consist of the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Sells Apple's hardware products and services in Europe, India, the Middle East and Africa.
segments.evidence: Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa.

segments.name: Greater China
segments.description: Sells Apple's hardware products and services in China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
segments.evidence: Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan.

segments.name: Japan
segments.description: Sells Apple's hardware products and services to customers in Japan.
segments.evidence: The Company's reportable segments consist of the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

segments.name: Rest of Asia Pacific
segments.description: Sells Apple's hardware products and services in Australia, New Zealand and other Asian countries.
segments.evidence: Rest of Asia Pacific includes Australia, New Zealand and those Asian countries not included in the Company's other reportable segments.

revenueModel.text: Consumers, businesses, education, enterprise and government customers pay Apple for its hardware products, related services and resold third-party products sold through direct and indirect channels.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force.
